title.narrative: Envelop 1. Emergency response to winterization and floods in the western countryside of Aleppo.

description.narrative:
The project aims to implement integrated and harmonized activities in the humanitarian field within the ERL and EDU clusters in the rural of Aleppo in the Atareb subdistrict, which is considered an area with high severity. The project is designed to support life-sustaining, enhance access between camps and markets during the winter season, prepare roads with related systems for flood mitigation, and enhance access to educational services to promote a safe and dignified learning environment in unsupported educational facilities not covered by winter support, all of which are in line with winterization preparation and flood response 2022/2023 as the needs of the people of northwest Syria are expected to increase this winter. The project is designed to achieve integration at the community level. The project will include: 1 - Rehabilitation of seven axial roads with a length of 14.6 km, linking 17 camps to the markets in five villages in the Atareb countryside, where scraping, leveling, graveling, and spraying liquid asphalt MC0 works will be carried out. More than 33,390 displaced people will be able to benefit from roads in terms of access to markets and vice versa in response to the winter season and to mitigate the negative impacts of floods. There are sewage and drainage systems linked to the roads will be rehabilitated through the following processes: A- Rehabilitation of the sewage systems related to two of the seven roads that will be rehabilitated. Where fifteen manholes will be rehabilitated along the road. As their height must be increased due to its constriction, and some of them do not have covers while they are open, where stones and dirt fall inside them and roads are blocked and flooded. B- Rehabilitation and cleaning of water drainage systems related to two of the seven roads in the regions of Batbu and Ibin Samaan, where the two roads will be provided with 16 culverts (10 in Ibin Samaan and 6 in Batbu) in order to prevent the occurrence of floods, as happened the previous year. Also, there is a blocked channel on Batbo road will be cleaned of dirt and debris that came with last year's rainwater. 2 . 30 workers from both the IDPs and LCs will be selected to work in the rehabilitation of a central popular market in Kafr Karmin, where this market provides its services to approximately 7250 families. This market is linked with two roads from the seven roads that will be rehabilitated. This activity will also generate temporary income for those workers who will work for 30 days. (each beneficiary will receive $ 5 for every five hours of work per day). 3. Enhancing access to formal education services during the winter season by supporting 37 schools with 73392 litter of diesel fuel for heating. The 37 schools include 556 classes and each class consumes Approx.3 litter of diesel fuel each day. The support will be for 2 consecutive months. The schools provide education services to more than 14995 displaced and HCs students. The displaced children who are in the camps will also benefit from the rehabilitation of the roads, as this support will provide a safe and dignified learning environment for the children inside and outside the camps, especially during the severe cold.
This project will support 42094 beneficiaries affected by the Syrian crisis (6,724 men, 6,478 women, 13,951 boys, and 14,941 girls including 662 PWDs). All the people in the targeted villages and markets will benefit directly/indirectly from the project outcomes. The protection cluster recommendations will be taken into consideration, wherein all the population in the targeted locations will benefit from MASRRAT protection services in Aleppo, in the event of any GBV referral cases. The target villages are Kafr Nasih:1940 HC,978 IDPs - Batbu:1450 HC, 2200 IDPs - Ibin Samaan:3000 HCs,1000 IDPs- Babka:850 HCs, 450 IDPs - Kafr karmin:3500 HCs,950 IDP - Jeineh 6272 HCs amp 2026 DPs - Abzemo 4860HCs,420 IDP - Atareb 25800HCs8940 IDP
